children: Juventus Fan Token entered a partnership with Finom on September 2nd.
Finom became Juventus’s official business-to-business financial platform partner.
Shared determination, shared ambition. Welcome to the Juventus partner family, Finom! Our Official B2B Financial Platform Partner.

The Juventus Fan Token (JUV) is a blockchain-based utility token launched by Juventus F.C. in partnership with Socios.com to enable enhanced fan engagement. As the first football club to offer such a token, Juventus empowers fans to participate in club decisions and gain access to exclusive content, experiences, and rewards through tokenized interactions.

JUV operates on Socios.com, where users acquire tokens by exchanging CHZ (Chiliz’s native currency) for JUV via the app. The token is hosted on the Chiliz Chain, an Ethereum-based proof-of-authority sidechain. JUV holders can participate in club-sanctioned polls through smart contracts, granting them limited governance capabilities. The app serves as both the interface and ecosystem for purchasing, voting, and earning rewards.

JUV is a governance-focused utility token that serves as a digital key for fan interaction and influence. It enables participation in binding voting events and community initiatives. Token holders may earn rewards for app engagement and, in the future, may stake their JUV tokens for access to exclusive NFT-based benefits, further expanding its utility within the Juventus digital fan ecosystem.

title: Juventus Fan Token Partners With Finom
